card.name: Ability words after "who" or "you"
card.fires_on: The modal "can" or "could" (also "able") right after "patients who", "infants who" or "you", when it introduces an ability or a condition, such as who can swallow or who can become pregnant.

modes.label: Patients who can
modes.description: "can" after "patients who" or "infants who", describing a group defined by an ability or condition.
modes.example: Mixing REYATAZ oral powder with a beverage (milk, infant formula, or water) may be used for infants who<< can>> drink from a cup.

modes.label: Other ability wording
modes.description: "could", "able" or similar words after "who", "you" or "will be" in general text.
modes.example: safari outfitters who<< could>> muster the resources to bid and who had

card.writes: The promoted tokens are mostly Chinese words meaning suitable or helpful, with no clear link to the English text; the effect is weak.
card.plain: It marks words like "can" that say what a group of people is able to do, as in "patients who can swallow".
